entities.summary: Riley Armstrong is a Canadian professional ice hockey coach and a former player. He is currently the director of player development for the Philadelphia Flyers of the National Hockey League since 2023. He played two games with the San Jose Sharks of the National Hockey League (NHL) as a forward during the 2008–09 season.
